name: rattle-bounce
title: Rattle Bounce
description: Five bricks drop in, rattle into a pile, then fall away. Pure CSS keyframes, played once on mount.
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>
docs:
Installed `RattleBounce`. Import it from `@/components/ui/rattle-bounce` and render `<RattleBounce key={run} aria-label="Bricks rattling into a pile and falling away" />`.

It plays once on mount; change its `key` to play it again.
The keyframes live in the component file and React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once (`<style href precedence>`), so nothing is added to your global CSS. Colors come from the item's own variables (`--rattle-bounce-1`, `--rattle-bounce-2`, `--rattle-bounce-3`, `--rattle-bounce-surface`), with the upstream grays as fallbacks.

Reduced motion: opacity only. The bricks fade in and out on the same timeline, without moving.
